facts: NM State enters 2-4 overall and 1-1 in Conference USA; Sam Houston enters 1-5 overall and 0-2 in Conference USA.
NM State had 13 full days without a game after playing three games in 12 days.
James Jones leads NM State with 599 rushing yards through his first five games with the Aggies and is averaging 99.8 rushing yards per game.
NM State has 15 sacks through six games; the official Aggie preview notes Sam Houston has allowed 17 sacks.
Sam Houston's official game center lists Landyn Locke as its passing leader with 1,418 yards.
Sam Houston was held to 177 total yards and 112 passing yards in the Oct. 14 loss to WKU.
